name: Sports announcer
percent: And here comes the counter! {fact}! Within {gap} of that claim! Does it prove anything? IT DOES NOT!
{fact}! Ladies and gentlemen, by that logic {subject_or_that} is brought to you by {short}!
ratio: A MULTIPLIER! And what a comparison: {fact_lc}! Still no baseline in sight!
{fact}! {fact_v} times WHAT, though? That's the question nobody's answering!
He's going for the ratio! But {fact_lc}, and the scoreboard remains unchanged!
fallacy_percent: NO BASE RATE! You cannot run that play without telling us the rate among everyone else!
That's a correlation wearing a causation jersey, and the officials have seen it!
{v}% of people doing something tells you about the people, NOT about the thing!
fallacy_vague: 'MOST PEOPLE' is not a number! Where's the sample? Where's the year?
Appeal to the crowd! And the crowd, folks, is not a source!
fallacy_ratio: {v} TIMES MORE LIKELY! From what to what? One in a million to {v} in a million is still nothing!
A multiplier with no baseline! That's a foul in every league!
percent_close: OH, THAT'S A BIG NUMBER! But folks, {fact_lc}! SAME FIGURE! COMPLETELY UNRELATED! The crowd goes quiet!
WHAT A STATISTIC! And equally true: {fact_lc}! Two numbers, one coincidence, zero evidence!
fallacy_change: A {v}% {direction}! FROM WHAT?! Five to seven is up forty percent, folks!
NO STARTING POINT ON THE BOARD! A {v}% {direction} of almost nothing is still almost nothing!
fallacy_myth: IT'S A MYTH! Repeated for decades and NEVER measured! What a comeback from the facts!
appeal_authority: STUDIES SHOW! Which studies?! The ref wants to see the paperwork!
appeal_popularity: EVERYONE KNOWS! And everyone has been wrong before! Check the replay!
appeal_proof: PROVEN?! Proven by who?! We need a source on the field!
appeal_count: MILLIONS! Out of HOW MANY?! Give us the rate, not the crowd noise!
